answer.reason: Shiloh is the place where the tabernacle was set up and the land was divided, and which God later forsook.

clauses.english: was where the tabernacle was set up and Joshua divided the land by lot among the tribes
clauses.quote: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD

clauses.english: was where the LORD revealed himself to Samuel by his word
clauses.quote: the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD

clauses.english: was where the ark of the covenant was fetched from, to be carried into battle against the Philistines
clauses.quote: the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant

clauses.english: was forsaken by God, who gave up its tabernacle
clauses.quote: he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

doubts: GEN 49:10 'Shiloh' there is a word in Jacob's blessing of Judah, not clearly the city, so it was left out.
The 'Shilonite' verses (1KI 11:29, 1KI 12:15, 1KI 15:29, 2CH 9:29, 2CH 10:15) name the prophet Ahijah, not events of the place, so they were left out.
JER 7:12-14 and JER 26:6 speak of what God did to Shiloh without describing it, so they were not cited.
Minor events (Hannah's vow, the seizure of the women of Shiloh, Jeroboam's wife's visit) were left out to keep the line short.
